props.name: width
props.description:
The width, in dp, to report instead of the window's. Leave it out (or
`undefined`) and the real window width is reported, so the provider can sit
in place permanently and be switched on by a value.

props.name: axis
props.description:
Which axis the child is centred on. On the other axis it keeps its normal
place (the start, or the full width of a vertically centred child).
Defaults to `"both"`.

props.name: expanded
props.description:
Whether the panel is open. The accordion keeps its own open state: it
starts from this value, a press on the header toggles it, and it follows
the prop again whenever the prop changes. So it works as an initial state
(`expanded` alone) and as a controlled value (a parent that sets `expanded`
from `onClick`). Defaults to `false`.

props.name: icon
props.description:
The icon at the end of the header: a glyph name, or any node. It is drawn
as given; the default, a chevron, turns upside down while the panel is open.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called on every press of the header with the new state: `true` when it opens, `false` when it closes.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"outlined"` is a bordered panel on the surface, `"contained"` a filled
tonal one without a border. Defaults to `"outlined"`.

props.name: actions
props.description:
After the title: up to three action `IconButton`s per M3. Under a
navigator it defaults to `options.headerRight()`.

props.name: back
props.description: Truthy when a back destination exists (native-stack passes `{ title, href }`).

props.name: divider
props.description:
A hairline under the bar. Left out, it is drawn on the web when the bar
sits under a navigator and not otherwise.

props.name: elevated
props.description: The on-scroll state: `surfaceContainer` instead of `surface`.

props.name: isPinned
props.description: A pinned (always visible) drawer needs no menu button.

props.name: leading
props.description:
Before the title: typically a back or menu `IconButton`. Under a
navigator it defaults to a back button, or a menu button for a drawer.

props.name: navigation
props.description:
react-navigation's header contract, for a bar passed as a navigator's
`header`: `navigation.goBack` and `navigation.openDrawer` feed the leading
button. Structural, so any navigator's object fits; the library never
imports react-navigation.

props.name: options
props.description:
The screen's navigator options: `headerTitle` or `title` give the title,
`headerRight` the actions, and `headerLeft: null` or `hideMenuIcon` hides
the drawer's menu button.

props.name: paper
props.description:
Props of the `Paper` the bar is drawn on (`elevation`, `outline`, `glow`,
`style`), merged over the bar's own: `elevation` is `0`, or `2` when
`elevated`. `<AppBar paper={{ elevation: 3 }} />` lifts the bar to level 3.

props.name: route
props.description: The navigator's route: its `name` is the title when nothing else is.

props.name: safeArea
props.description: Pads the top safe-area inset. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: A second line under the title.

props.name: title
props.description:
The headline. A string is drawn in the variant's type style; any other
node is placed as is. Left out, it is read from `options` and `route`
(see `navigation`).

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"small"` and `"center"` keep the title in the 64dp row; `"medium"` and
`"large"` move it to a second, larger line. Defaults to `"small"`.

props.name: background
props.description:
Background — a theme colour token (`"surfaceContainer"`) or any colour
string.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Border colour — a theme colour token or any colour string.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between children, in px.

props.name: margin
props.description: Margin on every edge, in px. One edge or one axis goes through `style`.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding on every edge, in px. One edge or one axis goes through `style`.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius — a shape token name or a raw radius.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width divided by height — `16 / 9`, `1`, `4 / 3`. Defaults to `1`.

props.name: style
props.description: Merged last, over the variant and every other prop.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Layout preset: direction, centring and filling the parent. The other props
and `style` are applied on top of it.
- `standard`: a plain column (default).
- `flex`: a row.
- `column-flex`: a column.
- `centered-flex`: a row, centred on both axes.
- `centered-column-flex`: a column, centred on both axes.
- `full-page-flex`: a row that fills the screen (`flex: 1`, minimum height 100%).
- `full-page-column-flex`: the same, as a column.
- `full-size-flex`: a row, 100% wide and 100% high.
- `full-size-column`: a column, 100% wide and 100% high.
- `full-size-centered-flex`: a row, 100% x 100%, centred on both axes.
- `full-size-centered-column-flex`: a column, 100% x 100%, centred on both axes.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Lets children flow onto the next line (or column) instead of overflowing.

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Called with the text as it changes: typed, cleared, or filled in by a
picked option (its label; empty after a pick with `multiple`).

props.name: value
props.description: The text in the field. Free text is allowed — this is not a Select.

props.name: allowCustomValue
props.description:
Whether text that is not an option may stay in the field. Defaults to
`true`. With `false`, leaving the field puts back the chosen option's
label, or empties it when nothing is chosen (always empties it with
`multiple`, where the text is only a query).

props.name: clearable
props.description: Adds a clear button once there is text. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: debounce
props.description: Quiet time in ms before `onSearch`. Defaults to 300.

props.name: defaultOptions
props.description:
The suggestions offered while the field has fewer than `minChars`
characters — before the user has typed, or before a first search has
returned — instead of keeping the list closed. They are shown as given,
not filtered. From `minChars` on, the list is `options`. Leave out for
no list until the user types.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when nothing matches. Omit to hide the list instead.

props.name: filter
props.description:
Custom matcher. Defaults to a case- and accent-insensitive substring test
over `label`, or to no filtering at all when `onSearch` is given (the
server already filtered).

props.name: fullWidth
props.description:
Stretches the field to its container's width. `false` shrinks it to its
content, with a minimum width. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description:
Where the label is drawn: `"outside"` above the box, or `"inside"` within
it. Independent of `variant`. Defaults to `"outside"`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in the field — for options still being fetched.

props.name: maxSuggestions
props.description: Caps the visible suggestions. Defaults to 8.

props.name: minChars
props.description: Characters required before suggestions appear. Defaults to 1.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Picks one option (the default). Set to `true` to pick several.

props.name: onSearch
props.description:
Called with the text after the user stops typing for `debounce` ms, once
it has `minChars` characters, and with `""` when the field is cleared.
Fetch the options there and pass them in `options`; use `loading`
meanwhile. Not called for the text an option fills in.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called on every pick with the option, and with `null` when the choice is cleared.

props.name: selected
props.description:
The chosen option, kept apart from the text being typed. Pass it (even as
`null`) to control the choice; editing the text away from its label, or
clearing the field, reports `null` through `onSelectedChange`.

props.name: variant
props.description:
The look of the box: `"outlined"` is a bordered box on the surface,
`"filled"` a tinted box (like `PinInput`'s) that shows its border only
while focused or in error. Where the label sits is `labelPlacement`'s
business, not the variant's. Defaults to `"outlined"`.

props.name: name
props.description:
Initials are drawn from it when there is no `source`, and it is shown as a
tooltip on hover (web) or long press (native).

props.name: size
props.description: A size in pixels, or `"small"` (32), `"medium"` (40) or `"large"` (56). Defaults to `"medium"`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape: full circle, rounded corners, or square.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour role of the badge. Defaults to `"error"`.

props.name: max
props.description: Cap shown as "max+" when count exceeds it.

props.name: position
props.description:
The corner of the parent the badge is pinned to, overlapping it slightly.
Left out, the badge is only absolutely placed and the parent (or `style`)
positions it.

props.name: showZero
props.description: Render the badge even when count is 0 (hidden by default).

props.name: actions
props.description: Up to two actions, rendered right-aligned below the message.

props.name: dismissable
props.description: Show a close (X) button; requires onDismiss.

props.name: active
props.description: Blinks while true; stays at full opacity while false. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: children
props.description: What blinks: a dot, a badge, a line of text.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds one half of a blink takes: the fade down to `minOpacity`, and again the fade back up. Defaults to 600.

props.name: minOpacity
props.description: The opacity at the dimmest point of a blink, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.2.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called by the close button, a tap on the scrim, a drag down past the threshold and Android back.

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the sheet is open.

props.name: actions
props.description:
A row of buttons fixed at the bottom, below a divider, while the content
above it scrolls (named like `Dialog`'s `actions`).

props.name: maxHeightRatio
props.description: Max sheet height as a fraction of the window height.

props.name: showCloseButton
props.description: Adds a close button at the end of the title row. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: background
props.description:
Background — a theme colour token (`"surfaceContainer"`) or any colour
string.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Border colour — a theme colour token or any colour string.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between children, in px.

props.name: margin
props.description: Margin on every edge, in px. One edge or one axis goes through `style`.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding on every edge, in px. One edge or one axis goes through `style`.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius — a shape token name or a raw radius.

props.description:
Layout preset: direction, centring and filling the parent. The other props
and `style` are applied on top of it.
- `standard`: a plain column (default).
- `flex`: a row.
- `column-flex`: a column.
- `centered-flex`: a row, centred on both axes.
- `centered-column-flex`: a column, centred on both axes.
- `full-page-flex`: a row that fills the screen (`flex: 1`, minimum height 100%).
- `full-page-column-flex`: the same, as a column.
- `full-size-flex`: a row, 100% wide and 100% high.
- `full-size-column`: a column, 100% wide and 100% high.
- `full-size-centered-flex`: a row, 100% x 100%, centred on both axes.
- `full-size-centered-column-flex`: a column, 100% x 100%, centred on both axes.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Lets children flow onto the next line (or column) instead of overflowing.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Collapse middle items behind an ellipsis when exceeding this count.

props.name: block
props.description: Breaks out on both vertical edges: a spacing token or px.

props.name: blockEnd
props.description: Breaks out at the bottom; wins over `block`.

props.name: blockStart
props.description: Breaks out at the top; wins over `block`.

props.name: inline
props.description: Breaks out on both horizontal edges: a spacing token or px.

props.name: inlineEnd
props.description: Breaks out at the end edge (right in LTR); wins over `inline`.

props.name: inlineStart
props.description: Breaks out at the start edge (left in LTR); wins over `inline`.

props.name: badge
props.description:
A count shown after the label (a `Badge`): active filters, unread items.
Hidden at 0 or when left out.

props.name: busy
props.description:
Blocks presses and announces the button as busy, but — unlike `loading` —
keeps the label, the icon and the full-strength colours on screen.

props.name: color
density
props.description:
Control height. `"dense"` is for desktop forms and tables: about 36 px
instead of 48.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report the press to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch to fill the parent width.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Icon side relative to the label.

props.name: labelStyle
props.description: Applied to the label text, after the theme's type style.

props.name: type
props.description:
`"submit"` submits the enclosing `Form` when pressed, after `onClick`, on
every platform. While the form submits (an async `onSubmit` or validator
is running) it shows `loading`, and it is `disabled` with the form. A
button outside a `Form` ignores it. Defaults to `"button"`.

props.name: underlay
props.description:
Drawn behind the label across the whole surface, clipped to its shape:
a progress fill, a state animation. It receives no touches.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected value, or the selected values with `multiSelect`.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Names the group for assistive tech.

props.name: mode
props.description: Look of the unselected buttons; selected ones are filled. Defaults to `"tonal"`.

props.name: size
props.description: Defaults to `"s"` (40dp).

props.name: type
props.description:
`"standard"` spaces the buttons apart; `"connected"` joins them into one
control (the successor of segmented buttons). Defaults to `"standard"`.

props.name: selected
props.description: Draws the card as the chosen one of a set (a primary border) and says so to screen readers.

props.name: align
props.description: Where the buttons sit on the row. M3 puts card actions on the right.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alternative text — an unnamed image is invisible to a screen reader.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width divided by height. M3 card covers default to 16:9.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: Trailing slot — an `IconButton`, a `Menu` anchor, a `Chip`.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Leading slot — an `Avatar`, an `Icon`, a `StatusBadge`.

props.name: autoPlayInterval
props.description: Auto-advance interval in ms; 0 disables auto-play.

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed height; otherwise sized by the tallest page.

props.name: showArrows
props.description: Overlay prev/next arrow buttons.

props.name: background
props.description:
Background — a theme colour token (`"surfaceContainer"`) or any colour
string.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Border colour — a theme colour token or any colour string.

props.name: direction
props.description:
Whether the children flow in a row or in a column; either way each is
centred on both axes. Defaults to `"row"`.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between children, in px.

props.name: margin
props.description: Margin on every edge, in px. One edge or one axis goes through `style`.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding on every edge, in px. One edge or one axis goes through `style`.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius — a shape token name or a raw radius.

props.description: Merged last, over the variant and every other prop.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Lets children flow onto the next line (or column) instead of overflowing.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report the toggle to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Mixed state (e.g. "select all" with partial selection); overrides the checkmark.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Receives the new set of checked values after each toggle.

props.name: value
props.description: The values of the checked options.

props.name: direction
props.description: Stacks the options (`"column"`) or lays them in a wrapping line (`"row"`). Defaults to `"column"`.

props.name: error
props.description: Error text below the group; it also turns the checkboxes and the label red.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report each toggle to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the group; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the label with an asterisk.

props.name: accessibilityRole
props.description:
Overrides the role of a pressable chip (`"button"`). A chip that toggles
inside a group is a `"radio"` or a `"checkbox"`, and then reports
`selected` as checked.

props.name: border
props.description:
Corner shape: `"rounded"` (the default), `"squared"` for square corners,
`"circular"` for a pill.

props.name: color
props.description:
Colour role. `filled` takes the role's accent, `tonal` its container,
`outlined` draws the label and the outline in it. Left out, the chip keeps
the neutral secondary look. `toneFrom` wins over it.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report presses: a `"checkbox"` chip toggles, a `"radio"` one selects to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: size
props.description: "small" renders a compact 24px chip, "large" a 40px one.

props.name: toneFrom
props.description:
Tints a `"filled"` or `"tonal"` chip from a `#RRGGBB` colour or from any
text (the same text always gives the same colour), readable in light and dark.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected value (or `null`), or the selected values with `multiple`.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Names the group for assistive tech.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Filter chips: any number selected. Defaults to `false` (one at most).

props.name: required
props.description: Single select only: the selected chip cannot be deselected.

props.name: variant
props.description: Chip look. Defaults to `"outlined"`, the M3 filter chip.

props.name: wrap
props.description: `true` wraps onto more lines; `false` scrolls sideways. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: value
props.description: The text a press copies.

props.name: children
props.type: | React.ReactNode | ((state: { copied: boolean; copy: () => Promise<boolean>; }) => React.ReactNode)
props.description:
Draws your own trigger instead of the default icon button. A node is the
content of a pressable (a button inside it would nest buttons: draw the
trigger yourself for that); a function gets `{ copied, copy }`, `copy`
copying `value`, and is drawn as returned, the trigger being yours.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour role of the default `IconButton`. The confirmation is always `success`.

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the trigger after the copy, also announced to screen readers. Defaults to `"Copied"`.

props.name: copy
props.description:
Writes the text. On web it defaults to `navigator.clipboard.writeText`
(with an `execCommand("copy")` fallback). On native there is no default:
pass one (`expo-clipboard`'s `setStringAsync`), or the trigger is drawn
only with an `onCopy` that does the copying, and nothing without either.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label of the trigger before the copy. Defaults to `"Copy"`.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called with `value` after it was copied.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the default `IconButton`. Defaults to `"large"`, the 48 dp touch target; `"small"` suits a button beside a value.

props.name: style
props.description: Style of the trigger.

props.name: timeout
props.description: How long the confirmation (the check, `copied`) shows, in ms. Defaults to 1500.

props.name: variant
props.description: Container style of the default `IconButton`. Defaults to `"standard"`.

props.name: code
props.description: The source to show.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Read by screen readers as the name of the block. Defaults to the title, or "{LANGUAGE} code".

props.name: copy
props.description:
Writes the copied text: `expo-clipboard`'s `setStringAsync` on native. On
web it defaults to `navigator.clipboard.writeText`.

props.name: copyable
props.description:
Shows a copy button in the header. On web it works as is; on native it is
drawn only with a `copy` writer or an `onCopy`. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: highlightLines
props.description: Lines to mark with a band and an accent edge, counted from 1.

props.name: language
props.description: What it is written in, for the colours. Defaults to `"tsx"`.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Height of the block's body before it scrolls vertically. Left out, it grows with the code.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called with the code after the copy button copied it.

props.name: showLineNumbers
props.description: Numbers the lines, in a gutter that is not selected with the code.

props.name: title
props.description: Shown above the snippet: a file name, or what it is for. Defaults to the language's name.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wraps long lines instead of scrolling the block sideways.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the content is expanded.

props.name: animateOpacity
props.description: Fades the content along with the height change. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: collapsedHeight
props.description: Height kept visible while collapsed — a peek/teaser. Defaults to 0.

props.name: duration
props.description: Transition length in ms. Defaults to 200.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Skips unmounting the children while collapsed. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: columns
props.description:
The columns, in order. Keep the array stable (`useMemo`), and `onClick`
too (`useCallback`): a row is drawn again only when something it shows
changes, which a new array every render defeats.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height; follows `ThemeProvider`'s `density` unless set here.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown centered when data is empty and not loading.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Drawn instead of `emptyMessage` when data is empty and not loading: an illustration, a call to action.

props.name: height
props.description:
Height of the grid. The header stays in place and the rows scroll under it
(a virtualised list). Without it the grid fills the height of its container,
which must then be bounded for the rows to scroll.

props.name: hover
props.description: Highlights the row under the pointer, on web; a row with `onClick` also highlights while pressed.

props.name: onClick
props.description:
Called with the row and its index in `data` when a row is pressed. Giving it
makes the rows pressable: a button on iOS and Android, where a cell then
should not hold a control of its own (the row is read as one element); a
focusable row on the web, which Enter presses.

props.name: rowsPerPage
props.description:
Rows per page. A number slices `data` into pages and shows a `Pagination`
under the grid (hidden while there is no data); the page goes back to the
first when `rowsPerPage` or the number of rows changes. Left out, every row
is one scrolling list. Not meant to be combined with `onEndReached`: a page
is finished by the user, not by scrolling.

props.name: rowStyle
props.type: ViewStyle | ((row: any, index: number) => ViewStyle | undefined)
props.description: One style for every row, or a function of the row (to dim or highlight one).

props.name: selected
props.description:
The row index, or indexes, to draw as selected. An index is a position in
`data`, not in the page shown, so it follows the order `data` is given in
(sort the rows before passing them). The row is marked selected for
assistive technology too.

props.name: tableTitle
props.description: A heading drawn above the header row.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the grid. Without it the grid fills its container.

props.name: value
props.description: `null` renders `placeholder` instead of a formatted value.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Adds a clear affordance to the field. Needs `onClear` to do anything.

props.name: defaultInputType
props.description:
Which surface the dialog opens on, `"picker"` or typed `"keyboard"` entry.
There is no toggle between the two in the dialog, so this is the only way
to get typed entry there. Default `"picker"`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Mount with the picker already open. Uncontrolled after that.

props.name: endYear
props.description: Last year offered by the year grid. Defaults to 100 years on.

props.name: error
props.description: Error text below the field; also recolors the field.

props.name: fieldVariant
props.description:
The look of the field's box, as `variant` on `Input`: `"outlined"` is a
bordered box on the surface, `"filled"` a tinted box that shows its border
only while the picker is open, the typed text has focus, or there is an
`error`. Named apart from `variant`, which already chooses between the
field and the inline picker. Does nothing for `variant="static"`, which has
no field. Defaults to `"outlined"`.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Defaults to the locale's own week start.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: inputEnabled
props.description: Lets the user type the value straight into the field. Default `true`.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Excludes days `validRange` cannot express (weekends, a computed holiday set).

props.name: labels
props.description: Chrome strings of the picker surface (nav buttons, "Today", "OK", …).

props.name: locale
props.description: Overrides the formatting/labelling locale. Defaults to the device locale.

props.name: minuteInterval
props.description: Minute granularity of the clock. Defaults to 1.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field has no value.

props.name: presentation
props.description:
Web only, `variant="default"` only: whether the picker opens docked to its
field or as a dialog. Decided each time it opens. Native always opens the
dialog. Defaults to `"auto"`.

props.name: relativeLabels
props.description:
Overrides the relative day labels, e.g. from i18n:
`relativeLabels={{ today: t("TODAY"), yesterday: t("YESTERDAY") }}`.
Defaults to the device locale via Intl.RelativeTimeFormat.

props.name: required
props.description: Appends an asterisk to the label.

props.name: scrollMode
props.description: Month navigation inside the dialog. Default `"endless"`.

props.name: showOkButton
props.description:
Shows the OK button in the popup. Default `true`. Set to `false` and the
picker finishes by itself instead of waiting for OK: a time is set and the
popup closes once the minute is picked (`mode="datetime"`: after the day,
the hour and the minute), and a date range once its second end is. A single
date already closes on the tap. It has no effect on `selectionMode="multiple"`,
which cannot tell when it is finished, nor on typed entry
(`defaultInputType="keyboard"`), which keeps its OK; and a
`variant="static"` picker has no popup, so it does nothing there.

props.name: showToday
props.description:
Offers a "Today" button next to the month arrows. Default `true`. Only a
single-date calendar has one, and it is disabled while today is outside
`validRange` or excluded by `isDateDisabled`.

props.name: startYear
props.description: First year offered by the year grid. Defaults to 100 years back.

props.name: use24HourClock
props.description: Forces the 24-hour clock face. Left unset, the locale decides.

props.name: validRange
props.description: The selectable window plus individual excluded days.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"default"` shows a field that opens the picker in a popover (web) or a
dialog; dismiss it by tapping outside, with the back gesture or with Escape.
`"static"` draws the picker inline in the page instead: no field, no popup,
no OK, and every selection calls `onChange` at once with the live value.
Of the field props only `disabled` and `style` apply to a static picker, and
it always shows the calendar and the clock, never typed entry.

props.name: value
props.description: `null` renders `placeholder` instead of a formatted value.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Adds a clear affordance to the field. Needs `onClear` to do anything.

props.name: defaultInputType
props.description:
Which surface the dialog opens on, `"picker"` or typed `"keyboard"` entry.
There is no toggle between the two in the dialog, so this is the only way
to get typed entry there. Default `"picker"`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Mount with the picker already open. Uncontrolled after that.

props.name: endYear
props.description: Last year offered by the year grid. Defaults to 100 years on.

props.name: error
props.description: Error text below the field; also recolors the field.

props.name: fieldVariant
props.description:
The look of the field's box, as `variant` on `Input`: `"outlined"` is a
bordered box on the surface, `"filled"` a tinted box that shows its border
only while the picker is open, the typed text has focus, or there is an
`error`. Named apart from `variant`, which already chooses between the
field and the inline picker. Does nothing for `variant="static"`, which has
no field. Defaults to `"outlined"`.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Defaults to the locale's own week start.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: inputEnabled
props.description: Lets the user type the value straight into the field. Default `true`.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Excludes days `validRange` cannot express (weekends, a computed holiday set).

props.name: labels
props.description: Chrome strings of the picker surface (nav buttons, "Today", "OK", …).

props.name: locale
props.description: Overrides the formatting/labelling locale. Defaults to the device locale.

props.name: minuteInterval
props.description: Minute granularity of the clock. Defaults to 1.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field has no value.

props.name: presentation
props.description:
Web only, `variant="default"` only: whether the picker opens docked to its
field or as a dialog. Decided each time it opens. Native always opens the
dialog. Defaults to `"auto"`.

props.name: relativeLabels
props.description:
Overrides the relative day labels, e.g. from i18n:
`relativeLabels={{ today: t("TODAY"), yesterday: t("YESTERDAY") }}`.
Defaults to the device locale via Intl.RelativeTimeFormat.

props.name: required
props.description: Appends an asterisk to the label.

props.name: scrollMode
props.description: Month navigation inside the dialog. Default `"endless"`.

props.name: showOkButton
props.description:
Shows the OK button in the popup. Default `true`. Set to `false` and the
picker finishes by itself instead of waiting for OK: a time is set and the
popup closes once the minute is picked (`mode="datetime"`: after the day,
the hour and the minute), and a date range once its second end is. A single
date already closes on the tap. It has no effect on `selectionMode="multiple"`,
which cannot tell when it is finished, nor on typed entry
(`defaultInputType="keyboard"`), which keeps its OK; and a
`variant="static"` picker has no popup, so it does nothing there.

props.name: showToday
props.description:
Offers a "Today" button next to the month arrows. Default `true`. Only a
single-date calendar has one, and it is disabled while today is outside
`validRange` or excluded by `isDateDisabled`.

props.name: startYear
props.description: First year offered by the year grid. Defaults to 100 years back.

props.name: use24HourClock
props.description: Forces the 24-hour clock face. Left unset, the locale decides.

props.name: validRange
props.description: The selectable window plus individual excluded days.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"default"` shows a field that opens the picker in a popover (web) or a
dialog; dismiss it by tapping outside, with the back gesture or with Escape.
`"static"` draws the picker inline in the page instead: no field, no popup,
no OK, and every selection calls `onChange` at once with the live value.
Of the field props only `disabled` and `style` apply to a static picker, and
it always shows the calendar and the clock, never typed entry.

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the dialog is on screen.

props.name: actionText
props.description: Label of the primary action. Defaults to `"OK"`.

props.name: cancelText
props.description:
Label of the secondary action, drawn before the primary one. Left out,
the alert has the primary action only.

props.name: children
props.description: More body under the `message`, or in its place: a string or any node.

props.name: destructive
props.description: Draws the primary action in the error tone (delete, discard).

props.name: disableBackdropClick
props.description:
Keeps a click on the backdrop from calling `onCancel`: an alert needs an
answer. Set `false` to let it dismiss. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: disableEscapeKeyDown
props.description:
Keeps Escape (web) and Android back from calling `onCancel`. Set `false`
to let them dismiss. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Hero glyph above the title; takes the place of the `severity` icon.

props.name: loading
props.description:
The primary action shows a spinner and does nothing, the secondary one is
disabled, and the alert stays until `visible` goes down: dismissing it is
off while it works.

props.name: message
props.description: What the alert says. With the `children`, it is the dialog's accessible description.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called when the primary action is pressed.

props.name: onCancel
props.description:
Called when the secondary action is pressed, and when the backdrop,
Escape or Android back dismiss the alert (once enabled).

props.name: severity
props.description:
Puts a status icon above the title, in the colour of the status role.
Left out, no icon.

props.name: slotStyles
props.description: As `Dialog`; `actions` covers the buttons and `title` the headline.

props.name: testID
props.description: Root testID. The buttons get `${testID}-cancel` and `${testID}-action`. Defaults to `"alert-dialog"`.

props.name: title
props.description: The headline. It is the dialog's accessible name.

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the dialog is on screen.

props.name: actions
props.description:
Trailing action row. Replaces the single `closeText` button. In a
full-screen dialog it moves into the header, after the title.

props.name: closeIcon
props.description:
The close icon in the header, shown while `onClose` is set: a glyph name,
your own element, or `false` to hide it. Hidden, a dialog without
`actions` falls back to a text button labelled `closeText`.
Defaults to `"close"`.

props.name: closeText
props.description: Accessible name of the close icon, and the label of the fallback close button.

props.name: describedBy
props.description:
The `nativeID` of the element that describes the dialog (an alert's
message), set as `aria-describedby`. Only used with `role`.

props.name: disableBackdropClick
props.description: Keeps a click on the backdrop from calling `onClose`. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: disableEscapeKeyDown
props.description:
Keeps Escape (web) and Android back from calling `onClose`. Turn it on
for a decision the user must not be able to skip. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: form
props.description:
Wraps the body and the `actions` in a `Form`, so a `Button
type="submit"` in `actions` (or Enter in a field, on the web) calls
`onSubmit`. In a `fullScreen` dialog the header is inside it too.

props.name: fullScreen
props.description:
The M3 full-screen dialog, for a form on a compact window: it fills the
window, with a close button, the title and `actions` in a header row and
a scrolling body. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: height
props.description:
A fixed height for the dialog card, in px or as a percentage of the
window (`"60%"`). The body scrolls when the content is taller. The card
never grows past 90% of the window. Ignored by `fullScreen`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Hero glyph above the title (M3 dialog icon). Centres the header.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description:
Web: where focus goes once the dialog is open. `"auto"` leaves it to the
modal's focus trap, which takes the first focusable element (the close
icon, or a field in the body). `"actions"` focuses the first control of
the `actions` row, so an alert starts on its least destructive button.
Ignored by `fullScreen`. Defaults to `"auto"`.

props.name: onClose
props.description:
Asks the dialog to close: called by the close icon, a click on the
backdrop, Escape (web) and Android back. Without it the dialog has no
way to close itself, so `visible` stays up to the app.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called when the `form` is submitted. Only used with `form`.

props.name: role
props.description:
The ARIA role of the card, for the web and for screen readers elsewhere.
`"alertdialog"` marks a dialog that interrupts to ask for an answer (see
`AlertDialog`); the title then names the card. Left out, the card has no
role of its own and react-native-web's modal supplies `dialog`.

props.name: scrollable
props.description: Scrolls the body when the content is taller than the dialog.

props.name: slotStyles
props.description: Style overrides for the parts of the dialog, merged after its own styles.

props.name: testID
props.description: Root testID. The scrim gets `${testID}-scrim`, the close icon `${testID}-close`, the form `${testID}-form`.

props.name: width
props.description:
How wide the dialog may grow on a wide window: `"xs"` 360, `"sm"` 480,
`"md"` 560, `"lg"` 800. Defaults to `"md"`. Ignored by `fullScreen`.

props.name: children
props.description:
Centred label, splitting the rule in two. Horizontal only — a vertical
divider is a bare rule.

props.name: contentSpacing
props.description: Gap between the label and each half of the rule. No label, no gap.

props.name: inset
props.description: Margin at both ends of the line, along its own axis.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Line thickness, in pixels.

props.name: children
props.type: | React.ReactNode | ((state: { download: () => Promise<boolean>; downloading: boolean; }) => React.ReactNode)
props.description:
The button's label, `"Download"` if left out. A function draws your own
trigger instead of the button: it gets `{ download, downloading }`,
`download` saving this file, and is drawn as returned.

props.name: color
props.description: The button's colour role. Defaults to `"primary"`.

props.name: data
props.description:
The content: a string (saved as text), an object (saved as JSON) or a
`Blob` (any binary file). Wins over `url` when both are given.

props.name: filename
props.description: The saved file's name. Defaults to the last part of `url`, else `download` (`download.json`, `download.txt` for `data`).

props.name: icon
props.description: The button's icon. Defaults to `"download"`.

props.name: mimeType
props.description:
The media type. Defaults to the one the extension of `filename` tells,
else `application/json` for an object, `text/plain` for a string, the
`Blob`'s own type or the response's.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Called with the file after it was saved.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called when fetching or saving failed.

props.name: save
props.description:
Saves the file. On web it defaults to a temporary `<a download>` link; on
native to the system share sheet with the text (or the link), which is
enough for text and links. Pass one to write real files
(`expo-file-system` + `expo-sharing`) and for a `Blob`.

props.name: style
props.description: Style of the button.

props.name: url
props.description:
A file to fetch. On web it is fetched into a `Blob` first, as browsers
ignore `download` on a cross-origin link. On native it is not fetched: the
`save` writer gets it as `file.url` and downloads it its own way
(`expo-file-system`), and without a writer it is shared as a link.

props.name: variant
props.description: The button's variant. Defaults to `"filled"`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value to start from when uncontrolled. Defaults to `""`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the text and keeps it from opening.

props.name: editing
props.description: Controls whether the field is open; pair with `onEditingChange`.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description:
Fills the width of its container, in display and in edit alike. Left off,
the display is as wide as its text and the open field takes exactly that
width (at least 120 px), so opening it moves nothing; a textarea keeps the
width and grows in height. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the display button and of the open field. Not drawn.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called with the value the edit started from when it is cancelled (Escape or the close button).

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Called with the text on every edit while the field is open. When the edit
is cancelled it is called once more with the value the edit started from.

props.name: onEditingChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the edit starts, is confirmed or is cancelled.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the value when the edit is confirmed (Enter, blur or the check button, per `submitMode`).

props.name: options
props.description: The choices of a `type="select"`. The display shows the label of the selected one.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Drawn in the muted tone when the value is empty. Defaults to `"Edit"`.

props.name: precision
props.description: For `type="number"`: the decimals the field keeps.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the text as plain text, with no way to open it.

props.name: renderDisplay
props.description: Draws the displayed value your way (a link, a badge, a formatted amount) instead of as text.

props.name: selectAllOnFocus
props.description: Selects the whole text when the field opens, to type over it. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: showControls
props.description:
Shows the check and close buttons whatever the `submitMode`. With them
shown, leaving the field no longer confirms it. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the text, the pencil and the open field (`"small"` is dense). Defaults to `"medium"`.

props.name: startWithEditView
props.description: Mounts with the field already open (uncontrolled). Defaults to `false`.

props.name: submitMode
props.description:
What confirms the edit: `"blur"` (focus leaving the field), `"enter"`
(Enter), `"both"`, or `"none"`, which shows check and close buttons to
confirm and cancel with. Escape cancels in every mode. Defaults to
`"both"`.

props.name: testID
props.description: Root testID. The open field gets `${testID}-input`, the buttons `${testID}-save` and `${testID}-cancel`.

props.name: textVariant
props.description: The type-scale role of the displayed text, over what `size` picks.

props.name: type
props.description:
The field that opens: `"text"` is an `Input`, `"textarea"` an
`InputArea` (Enter adds a line; Ctrl or Cmd + Enter confirms), `"number"` an
`Input type="number"` (the value stays plain text) and `"select"` a
`Select` that is already open, which confirms on the pick. Defaults to
`"text"`.

props.name: validate
props.description:
Checks the value: return the message to show as the field's error, or
`undefined` when it is fine. While there is an error the edit cannot be
confirmed.

props.name: value
props.description: The value, as text (for `type="number"` too: `"12.50"`, as `Input` has it). Controlled; pair with `onChange`.

props.name: variant
props.description: The look of the open field: `"outlined"` or `"filled"`, as in `Input`. Defaults to `"outlined"`.

props.name: animateFrom
props.description: `animated` only: edge the label grows from. Match it to the FAB's corner.

props.name: duration
props.description: `animated` only: animation duration (ms). Defaults to 150.

props.name: extended
props.description:
`animated` only. `true` shows the label, `false` collapses to the icon.
Drive it from a scroll offset to get the M3 "shrink on scroll" behaviour.
Defaults to `true`.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report the press to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: iconMode
props.description:
`animated` only. `static` keeps the icon put and slides the label out
beside it; `dynamic` lets the icon travel with the label as the pill grows.

props.name: label
props.description:
The text of `extended` and `animated`, and the accessible name of every
variant. Without it those two variants fall back to the icon alone.

props.name: size
props.description: Defaults to `"medium"`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Defaults to `"icon"`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every `FormField` and the form's submit buttons.

props.name: form
props.description:
The instance from `useForm()`, to read and drive the form from outside it
(`form.setValue`, `form.reset()`, `useWatch("name", form)`). Without it
the form keeps its own, reachable from inside through the hooks.

props.name: initialValues
props.description:
Values the fields start from, as `{ email: "", address: { city: "" } }`.
Read when the form mounts; `form.reset(values)` starts over with new ones.
Give every field one (or its own `initialValue`): a field with none has
the value `undefined`.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description:
Called with the values when the form is submitted and every field passes
its rules: a `Button type="submit"` inside it is pressed, or (on the web)
Enter is pressed in one of its fields. It may be async: the form's
`isSubmitting` (and a submit `Button`'s `loading`) stay true until it
settles, and a second submission is ignored meanwhile. A form of
parent-held state, with no `FormField`, calls it too (with `{}`).

props.name: onSubmitFailed
props.description: Called instead of `onSubmit` when a field fails its rules, with the messages by field name and the values.

props.name: onValuesChange
props.description:
Called after a field's value changes (a user edit, `setValue`,
`setValues`; not `reset`) with just what changed, nested like the values
(`{ address: { city: "Rome" } }`), and with all of them.

props.name: validateOn
props.description:
When a field is validated: `"change"` after every edit, `"blur"` when it
is left, `"submit"` only on submit. After a submit, or once a field shows
an error, an edit validates it again whatever the mode, so a fixed field
clears at once. A `FormField` can override it. Defaults to `"change"`.

props.name: children
props.description:
The one control to connect, which receives the value, the trigger,
`onBlur`, `error`, `required` and `disabled` as props. Or a function
that gets those props and returns the control, for a control whose
required props (`Input` needs `value` and `onChange`) you would otherwise
have to write out: `{(field) => <Input label="Email" {...field} />}`.

props.name: name
props.description:
The field's name in the form's values: `"email"`, `"address.city"`,
`"items[0].qty"` (dots and brackets both nest).

props.name: control
props.description:
For a child that draws no label, helper or error text of its own
(`Checkbox`, `Switch`, `Slider`, `RadioGroup`): wraps it in a
`FormControl` that does, and passes it `error` as a boolean (and no
`required`, `label` or `helperText`: `FormControl` draws those). Defaults
to `false`.

props.name: dependencies
props.description:
Names of other fields this one's rules read (`"password"` for a
"confirm password"): it is validated again when one changes, once it
has been touched or edited, or shows an error.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables this field (the child's `disabled`); the form's `disabled` does it for all.

props.name: getValueFromEvent
props.description:
Turns what the trigger is called with into the value to store. By default
the first argument, or, when that is a DOM event, its `target.value`
(`target.checked` for `valuePropName="checked"`).

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text, passed to the child as `helperText` (or drawn by `FormControl` with `control`). Hidden while there is an error.

props.name: initialValue
props.description: The value the field starts with when the form's `initialValues` has none for it.

props.name: label
props.description:
Label, passed to the child as its `label` (`Input`, `Select`... draw it).
With `control`, drawn above the child by `FormControl` instead.

props.name: normalize
props.type: (value: any, previous: any, values: FormValues) => unknown
props.description: Turns the reported value into the stored one: `(value, previous, allValues) => stored`. Trim, uppercase, format.

props.name: rules
props.description: What the value must satisfy, checked in order; the first failure is the field's `error`.

props.name: trigger
props.description:
The child's callback that reports a new value. `"onValueChange"` for a
`Checkbox` or a `Slider`. Defaults to `"onChange"`.

props.name: validateOn
props.description: Overrides the form's `validateOn` for this field: a `Checkbox` has no blur, so `"change"` suits it.

props.name: valuePropName
props.description:
The child's prop that takes the value. `"checked"` for a `Checkbox`.
Defaults to `"value"`.

props.name: error
props.description: Error text below the control. Its presence marks the group invalid.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the control; hidden while `error` is set.

props.name: autoSize
props.description:
Sizes the children of a container that have no `size` of their own, so
they do not need one each. `true` is a card per row on a phone, two from
`sm` and three from `md` (`{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 4 }`, for 12 columns); a
size gives every child that size; a function is called with the index and
the element of each child (its `key` is `child.key`) and returns its size:
`(index, child) => child.key === "notes" ? { xs: 12 } : { xs: 12, md: 6 }`.
A child that is not a `Grid` is put in an item of the size it gets.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns in a row of this container; an item's `size` counts in them.

props.name: container
props.description:
Makes this grid lay its children out in rows of `columns` columns. The
grid items go inside it, each with its own `size`. A container inside
another container is also an item of it, and takes a `size` too.

props.name: size
props.description:
An item's width in the container's row: a number of columns (1 to
`columns`), `"grow"` to share the rest of the row, `"auto"` to size to its
content, or an object with one of those for each breakpoint
(`{ xs: 12, md: 6 }`). A breakpoint without a value takes the next smaller
one that has; with none, the item is `"auto"`. Without `size` an item is
`"auto"`, unless the container has `autoSize`.

props.name: spacing
props.description:
Gap between the items of a container: a number of px, a spacing token name
(`"m"`), or `{ row, column }` of those for the two axes.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Whether a container moves items that do not fit onto the next row.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the text to match a disabled field.

props.name: padding
props.description: `none` removes the 16px gutter that aligns the text with the field body.

props.name: type
props.description: `error` switches to the error role and shows the alert glyph.

props.name: visible
props.description: Fades the text out instead of unmounting it, so the field doesn't jump.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger. It is not wrapped in an accessible element of its own.

props.name: content
props.description: What the card shows: any node. It is supplementary, never the only way to something.

props.name: anchorPosition
props.description:
Places the card as `Popover` does (below, above or over the trigger,
aligned by its left edge, right edge or centre) instead of by
`placement`, which it replaces when given.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Web: how long after the pointer leaves the trigger and the card before it closes, in ms. Defaults to `150`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the card starts open (uncontrolled). Defaults to `false`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The card never opens, and closes if it was open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user opens or closes the card.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the card is open; pair with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: openDelay
props.description: Web: how long the pointer or focus rests on the trigger before the card opens, in ms. Defaults to `300`.

props.name: placement
props.description:
The side of the trigger the card opens on, centred on it. When that side
has no room the card goes to the opposite one, and it always stays inside
the window. Defaults to `"bottom"`.

props.name: style
props.description: Style of the trigger's wrapper, which shrinks to the trigger by default.

props.name: testID
props.description: Root testID. The card gets `${testID}-card`, the native outside-press layer `${testID}-backdrop`.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the card in px; it never grows past the window. Defaults to `280`.

props.name: flipForRTL
props.description: Mirror the glyph when the layout direction is RTL (arrows, chevrons).

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Required: an icon alone carries no accessible name.

props.name: badge
props.description: A count on the top-right corner (a `Badge`). Hidden at 0 or when left out.

props.name: color
props.description:
Colour role of the button. Left out, it keeps the neutral M3 look
(`onSurfaceVariant`, `primary` once selected).

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report the press (a toggle when `selected` is set) to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: selected
props.description: Renders the M3 "selected" container of a toggle icon button.

props.name: title
props.description:
A tooltip with this text: on hover or focus on the web, on long press on
native. It is a label for sighted users; `accessibilityLabel` stays the
accessible name.

props.name: variant
props.description: M3 icon-button container styles. Defaults to `"standard"`.

props.name: src
props.description: The address of the page to embed.

props.name: title
props.description: The frame's accessible name: what the embedded page is. Required, as a frame without one is announced as nothing.

props.name: allow
props.description: The `allow` attribute: the features the page may use (`"fullscreen; clipboard-write"`).

props.name: fallback
props.description: Drawn on iOS and Android instead of the page. Defaults to an icon and a short notice.

props.name: height
props.description: Defaults to 300.

props.name: loading
props.description: `"lazy"` loads the page when the frame comes near the viewport. Defaults to `"lazy"`.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called when the frame reports an error loading. Browsers rarely do for a page that fails to load.

props.name: onLoad
props.description: Called when the page has loaded.

props.name: referrerPolicy
props.description: The `referrerpolicy` attribute.

props.name: sandbox
props.description:
The `sandbox` attribute. `""` applies every restriction; a list of tokens
(`"allow-scripts allow-same-origin"`) lifts the ones named. Left out, the
page is not sandboxed.

props.name: style
props.description: Style of the box the frame fills: radius, border, margin, flex.

props.name: width
props.description: Defaults to the full width of the parent.

props.name: alt
props.description:
Alternative text. Required — an image with no accessible name is invisible
to screen readers.

props.name: fallbackIcon
props.description: Shown when loading fails and there is no `fallbackSource`.

props.name: fallbackSource
props.description: Swapped in when `source` fails to load.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius — a shape token name or a raw radius.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width divided by height. Use instead of `height` for fluid layouts.

props.name: showLoader
props.description: Renders a pulsing skeleton until the image resolves. Defaults to `true`.

Input.name: Input
Input.description:
A single-line text or number field. For text that wraps over several lines
use `InputArea`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new text on every edit (for `type="number"`, already cleaned).

props.name: allUpperCase
props.description: Capitalises what is typed (codes, plates, tax ids). Not for `type="number"`.

props.name: decimalSeparator
props.description:
The decimal mark a `type="number"` field types and shows: `","` for a user
who writes 12,50. `value` and `onChange` stay in the plain form
("12.50"), so the app parses nothing; a typed "." is then ignored, as a
thousands mark. Defaults to `"."`.

props.name: density
props.description: Control height. `"dense"` is for desktop forms and tables: a 40 px field instead of 56, 14 px text, less space below.

props.name: endAdornment
props.description:
Any element drawn at the end of the field, after `suffix` or
`trailingIcon` (which keep working): an `IconButton` with its own accessible
name, a spinner, a unit picker. It is not clipped by the field and takes
its own touches.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description:
Stretches the field to its container's width. `false` shrinks it to its
content, with a minimum width so an empty field stays usable. Defaults to
`true`.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: inputProps
props.description:
Autofill and keyboard hints, focus and key handling for the underlying
`TextInput`: `autoComplete`, `textContentType`, `autoCorrect`,
`autoCapitalize`, `spellCheck`, `autoFocus`, `selectTextOnFocus`,
`returnKeyType`, `enterKeyHint`, `onSubmitEditing`, `onKeyPress`,
`accessibilityLabel` / `accessibilityValue` (replace the ones drawn from
`label` and `value`) and `testID`.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: A ref to the underlying `TextInput`, to focus it or select its text.

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description:
Where the label is drawn: `"outside"` above the box, or `"inside"`, small,
above the text within it. Independent of `variant`. Defaults to `"outside"`.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Overrides the height `density` gives (56, or 40 when dense).

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the field loses focus.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Called when the field gains focus.

props.name: onTrailingIconPress
props.description: Pressing `trailingIcon`. It is a bare, unlabelled icon: for a real control use `endAdornment`.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the label with an asterisk.

props.name: reserveHelperText
props.description:
Keeps the line under the field even with no helper or error text, so a
message appearing does not push the next field down. Default false.

props.name: variant
props.description:
The look of the box: `"outlined"` is a bordered box on the surface,
`"filled"` a tinted box (like `PinInput`'s) that shows its border only
while focused or in error. Where the label sits is `labelPlacement`'s
business, not the variant's. Defaults to `"outlined"`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new text on every edit.

props.name: density
props.description: Control density: `"dense"` is 14 px text and less padding, for desktop forms.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description:
Stretches the field to its container's width. `false` shrinks it to its
content, with a minimum width. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: inputProps
props.description: Hints, focus and key handling for the underlying `TextInput`, as `Input`'s `inputProps`.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: A ref to the underlying `TextInput`, to focus it or select its text.

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description:
Where the label is drawn: `"outside"` above the box, or `"inside"`, small,
above the text within it. Independent of `variant`. Defaults to `"outside"`.

props.name: maxRows
props.description:
Without `rows`: the most lines the field grows to; past that its text
scrolls. Without it a field with `minRows` grows without limit. A value
under `minRows` is raised to it.

props.name: minRows
props.description:
Without `rows`: the field starts this many lines tall and grows with its
text (up to `maxRows`, if given). Defaults to 1 when only `maxRows` is
given.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the field loses focus.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Called when the field gains focus.

props.name: onTrailingIconPress
props.description: Pressing `trailingIcon`. It is a bare, unlabelled icon.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the label with an asterisk.

props.name: reserveHelperText
props.description:
Keeps the line under the field even with no helper or error text, so a
message appearing does not push the next field down. Default false.

props.name: rows
props.description:
Visible lines of a field of fixed height: it is exactly that tall and its
text scrolls inside. Wins over `minRows` and `maxRows`. With none of the
three given the field is 4 lines.

props.name: variant
props.description:
The look of the box: `"outlined"` is a bordered box on the surface,
`"filled"` a tinted box that shows its border only while focused or in
error. Defaults to `"outlined"`.

props.name: allowedSchemes
props.description:
URL schemes `href` may use. A link whose `href` came from data (a user's
website, a CMS field) must not be able to open `javascript:`, `intent:` or
another app's deep link. Add your own app's scheme here to deep-link.
Defaults to `["http", "https", "mailto", "tel"]`.

props.name: href
props.description:
Opened with `Linking.openURL`. Ignored when `onPress` is given, and when
its scheme is not in `allowedSchemes` — then the link does nothing.

props.name: showExternalIcon
props.description: Appends an external-link icon. Defaults to `true` when `href` is an `http` or `https` address.

props.name: underline
props.description: Underline behaviour. Defaults to `"hover"`.

props.name: variant
props.description: M3 typography variant for the label. Defaults to `"bodyMedium"`.

props.name: primaryText
props.description: The first line. Text is drawn in the theme's type; any other node is drawn as given.

props.name: action
props.description: Trailing slot: a value, a Switch, an `IconButton`, a chevron.

props.name: dimmed
props.description: Faded, for a row that is removed or inactive. Still pressable.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Fades the row and stops it being pressed. The `action` is not disabled with it: it is a control of its own.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading slot: a glyph name, or any node (an Avatar, a Checkbox).

props.name: indicatorColor
props.description: A coloured bar on the left edge, for a status or a priority.

props.name: onClick
props.description:
Called when the row is pressed. Giving it makes the whole row pressable,
the `action` zone included. The `action` is a sibling of the row's button,
never inside it: a control in it (an `IconButton`, a Switch) runs its own
handler and never this one, while a bare icon, chip or text there presses
the row.

props.name: primaryTextStyle
props.description: Merged after the type of `primaryText`; applies when it is text, a node styles itself.

props.name: secondaryText
props.description: Second line below `primaryText`. Text or any node, like `primaryText`.

props.name: secondaryTextStyle
props.description: Merged after the type of `secondaryText`; applies when it is text, a node styles itself.

props.name: trailingWidth
props.description: Fixes the width of the `action` slot and right-aligns it, so a column of rows lines its actions up.

props.name: variant
props.description:
How the row is drawn. `"contained"` (the default) fills it with the
`secondaryContainer` surface; `"outlined"` draws it on no fill with an
outline; `"standard"` is transparent with no border, like the rows of a
sidebar. The border is the same width in all three and in every state, so
hover and press never move the layout.

props.name: divider
props.description:
One rule below the section, after its last item: it closes the group, for
a settings screen of stacked groups. `showDividers` is the rules *between*
the items, and the two can be used together.

props.name: gap
props.description:
Space between consecutive items: a spacing token (`"xs"` 4, `"s"` 8, `"m"`
16, `"l"` 24, `"xl"` 32) or a number of pixels. Each `ListItem` already
keeps a small margin of its own: this is added to it.

props.name: showDividers
props.description:
A rule between each pair of consecutive items, so `n` items get `n - 1`
rules, none before the first or after the last (that one is `divider`).
With a `gap`, the rule sits in the middle of it.

props.name: title
props.description: Group label rendered above the rows as a heading.

props.name: anchor
props.description: The element the menu opens from.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on a press outside the menu, on Android back, and after an item is clicked when `closeOnSelect` is on.

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the menu is open.

props.name: anchorPosition
props.description:
Where the menu sits against its anchor: `vertical` is `"bottom"` (below
it), `"top"` (above it) or `"center"` (centred on it); `horizontal` lines
up the `"left"` edges, the `"right"` edges or the `"center"`s. It flips or
slides to stay on screen. Defaults to `{ vertical: "bottom", horizontal: "left" }`.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close the menu automatically after an item is clicked. Default true.

props.name: dividers
props.description: Draws a divider between every pair of items, on top of any `dividerAbove`. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called with the clicked item, after the item's own `onClick`.

props.name: selected
props.description:
The `id`s of the items to draw as selected: a tinted row with a check
mark, and `accessibilityState.selected` set on it. Items are not marked
until you pass it, even as `[]`.

props.name: activeId
props.description: `id` of the current destination.

props.name: items
props.description: Destinations, three to five per M3.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called with the `id` of the pressed destination.

props.name: safeArea
props.description:
Pads the bottom safe-area inset, so the bar clears the phone's gesture bar
or home indicator, as `AppBar` does at the top. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: "always" shows every label, "selected" only the active one.

props.name: children
props.description:
`DrawerSection`s and/or `DrawerItem`s, or any content when the drawer is a
side sheet (a form, filters, details).

props.name: actions
props.description: A row of buttons at the bottom, below a divider.

props.name: collapsed
props.description:
Icons only, 72 wide: labels, badges, titles and sub-items are hidden (an
item without an icon shows its first letter). Defaults to `false`.

props.name: elevation
props.description:
The level of the surface, 0 to 5: the tone it is painted in and, on iOS
and Android, its shadow. Defaults to `0` when static and `1` when
swipeable.

props.name: footer
props.description: Pinned below the scrolling items.

props.name: header
props.description: Pinned above the scrolling items: a logo, a site picker.

props.name: height
props.description: Top and bottom: the largest height, defaults to 360.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Shows a back button before the title, for a drawer with sub-pages.

props.name: onClose
props.description:
Called by the close button, and by a swipeable drawer's scrim, closing
drag, Android back and Escape (web).

props.name: position
props.description:
The window edge it is attached to: `"left"` and `"right"` are columns of
`width`, `"top"` and `"bottom"` span the full width and are as tall as
their content, up to `height`. The edges are physical, not mirrored in
right-to-left layouts. Defaults to `"left"`.

props.name: showCloseButton
props.description: Adds a close button to the header row, which calls `onClose`. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: title
props.description:
Headline at the top of the drawer. With a close button, a back button or
`actions` it is the title of a header row instead, in a larger type.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"static"` is a permanent panel in the layout, beside the content, with no
scrim. `"swipeable"` slides over the content on a scrim, and a drag toward
its edge, the scrim, Android back and Escape (web) close it.
Defaults to `"static"`.

props.name: visible
props.description: Swipeable only: whether the drawer is open.

props.name: width
props.description: Left and right: defaults to 360 (M3), capped at the window width when swipeable.

props.name: activeId
props.description: `id` of the current destination.

props.name: items
props.description: Destinations, same shape as `NavBar`'s. Three to seven per M3.

props.name: alignment
props.description: Where the destinations sit vertically. Defaults to `"top"`.

props.name: footer
props.description: Pinned to the bottom of the rail.

props.name: header
props.description: Above the destinations: typically a menu `IconButton` and/or a `FAB`.

props.name: showLabels
props.description:
`"always"` labels every destination, `"selected"` only the active one,
`"none"` none (the label is still the accessible name). Defaults to `"always"`.

props.name: activePage
props.description: Current page, 1-based.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the page the user picked: a page button, an arrow or `pageSelect`.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour role of the selected page. Defaults to `"primary"`.

props.name: pageSelect
props.description:
Adds a small select after the pager that jumps to any page: it shows the
active page, and opens a list of pages under a search field. Typing digits
narrows the list to the pages that contain them, which keeps it usable with
thousands of pages; Enter picks the first match.

props.name: showFirstLast
props.description: Show jump-to-first / jump-to-last arrows.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Pages shown on each side of the current page.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the buttons and their type: 32, 40 or 48 px. Defaults to `"md"`.

props.name: variant
props.description: `"rounded"` draws the buttons as rounded squares, `"circular"` as circles. Defaults to `"rounded"`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new text on every edit (for `type="number"`, already cleaned).

props.name: autoComplete
props.description:
What the platform's password manager should do: fill the saved password
(`"current-password"`) or offer to generate and save a new one
(`"new-password"`). Defaults to `"current-password"`.

props.name: defaultVisible
props.description: Whether the text starts revealed (uncontrolled). Defaults to `false`.

props.name: density
props.description: Control height. `"dense"` is for desktop forms and tables: a 40 px field instead of 56, 14 px text, less space below.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description:
Stretches the field to its container's width. `false` shrinks it to its
content, with a minimum width so an empty field stays usable. Defaults to
`true`.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: inputProps
props.description:
Autofill and keyboard hints, focus and key handling for the underlying
`TextInput`: `autoComplete`, `textContentType`, `autoCorrect`,
`autoCapitalize`, `spellCheck`, `autoFocus`, `selectTextOnFocus`,
`returnKeyType`, `enterKeyHint`, `onSubmitEditing`, `onKeyPress`,
`accessibilityLabel` / `accessibilityValue` (replace the ones drawn from
`label` and `value`) and `testID`.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: A ref to the underlying `TextInput`, to focus it or select its text.

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description:
Where the label is drawn: `"outside"` above the box, or `"inside"`, small,
above the text within it. Independent of `variant`. Defaults to `"outside"`.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Overrides the height `density` gives (56, or 40 when dense).

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the field loses focus.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Called when the field gains focus.

props.name: onVisibleChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the eye button is pressed.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the label with an asterisk.

props.name: reserveHelperText
props.description:
Keeps the line under the field even with no helper or error text, so a
message appearing does not push the next field down. Default false.

props.name: showStrength
props.description:
Draws a strength meter under the field once something is typed, scored by
`passwordStrength`. For a field that creates a password, not one that
enters it. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: showToggle
props.description:
Shows the eye button at the end of the field that reveals and hides the
text. Turn it off for a field that must never be revealed. Defaults to
`true`.

props.name: strengthLabels
props.description:
The words of the meter, from very weak (index 0) to strong (index 4).
Defaults to `["Very weak", "Weak", "Fair", "Good", "Strong"]`.

props.name: toggleLabels
props.description: The accessible names of the eye button. Default `Show password` / `Hide password`.

props.name: variant
props.description:
The look of the box: `"outlined"` is a bordered box on the surface,
`"filled"` a tinted box (like `PinInput`'s) that shows its border only
while focused or in error. Where the label sits is `labelPlacement`'s
business, not the variant's. Defaults to `"outlined"`.

props.name: visible
props.description: Controls whether the text is revealed; pair with `onVisibleChange`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the whole code, not the single cell, on every edit.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Cell edge length. Defaults to 48.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the cells; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: length
props.description: Number of cells. Defaults to 6.

props.name: mask
props.description: Renders dots instead of characters.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fired once the last cell is filled.

props.name: type
props.description: Restricts the accepted characters. Defaults to `"numeric"`.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Cell style: `"outlined"` draws each cell as a bordered box on the surface,
`"filled"` as a tinted box that shows its border only while focused or in
error. Defaults to `"outlined"`.

props.name: anchor
props.description: The element the popover opens from. It stays in the layout; the popover floats over the window.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called on a press outside the popover and on Android back.

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the popover is open.

props.name: anchorPosition
props.description:
Where the popover sits against its anchor: `vertical` is `"bottom"`
(below it), `"top"` (above it) or `"center"` (centred on it);
`horizontal` lines up the `"left"` edges, the `"right"` edges or the
`"center"`s. Whatever it asks, the popover flips or slides to stay on
screen. Defaults to `{ vertical: "bottom", horizontal: "left" }`.

props.name: matchAnchorWidth
props.description: Gives the popover the anchor's width instead of sizing it to its content.

props.name: color
props.description: Indicator colour. Defaults to `primary`.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hides it from assistive tech when something else announces the progress.

props.name: duration
props.description: Indeterminate only: one revolution, in ms.

props.name: label
props.description:
Text, a number or any node drawn with the ring, at `labelPosition`. Text
is drawn in the theme's type, scaled to the ring when it is inside; a node
as given.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description:
Where `label` goes: `"center"` inside the ring, or `"top"`, `"bottom"`,
`"left"` or `"right"` of it. Defaults to `"center"` for a ring with a
`progress` and to `"right"` for a spinner, which is too small to hold a label.

props.name: progress
props.description:
Completion from 0 to 1. Set, the ring fills to it over a track; unset,
the indicator spins (indeterminate).

props.name: trackColor
props.description:
The ring under the indicator. `true` draws it in the indicator's colour at
a low opacity, a string draws it in that colour, `false` draws none. Left
out, a ring with a `progress` has its usual track (`secondaryContainer`)
and a spinner has none.

props.name: decorative
props.description:
Hide the bar from assistive technology, for when the component around it
already announces the progress — a bar inside a button is not a second
control to land on.

props.name: height
props.description:
Bar thickness. A percentage fills the parent — a progress surface. Defaults
to 4, and to 20 when the label is `"inside"`, which has to fit on the bar.

props.name: label
props.description:
Text, a number or any node drawn with the bar, at `labelPosition`. Text is
drawn in the theme's type; a node as given.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description:
Where `label` goes: above (`"top-left"`, `"top-center"`, `"top-right"`) or
below (`"bottom-*"`) the bar, aligned as named, beside it (`"left"`,
`"right"`), or `"inside"`, centred on the bar. Inside, text is drawn in two
colours, over the filled part and over the track, so it reads on both; that
suits a bar with a `progress`, on an indeterminate one the text is only
legible over the track. Defaults to `"right"`.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the whole component, label included. Defaults to the full width of the parent.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessible name while idle. Falls back to the label.

props.name: children
