props.description: The idle label. Also the loading label unless `loadingLabel` is set.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of each progress step's transition, in ms.

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: Label once the task failed. The button stays pressable, to retry.

props.name: iconName
props.description: Leading icon while idle and loading.

props.name: indicator
props.description:
How progress is drawn inside the surface: `fill` sweeps a darker (or, in
the dark scheme, lighter) tone of the button across it; `bar` runs a 4dp
line along its bottom edge.

props.name: labelStyle
props.description: Applied to the label: font family, size, weight.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Label while loading, e.g. "Calculating route…".

props.name: onClick
props.description: Fires in every status but `loading`, where the button is busy.

props.name: onSuccessEnd
props.description: Called `successDuration` ms after the button turned to success.

props.name: progress
props.description:
Completion while `status` is `"loading"`, from 0 to 1. Leave it undefined
when the task cannot say how far along it is, for an indeterminate sweep.

props.name: progressColor
props.description: Colour of the fill or the bar. Derived from the button's colours if unset.

props.name: status
props.description:
Which moment of the task to show. Controlled: the button never moves
itself from one status to the next — the caller does, as the task reports.

props.name: style
props.description: Applied to the surface: corner radius, padding, width.

props.name: successDuration
props.description:
How long the success status holds before `onSuccessEnd` fires, in ms.
`0` keeps it until the caller changes `status`.

props.name: successLabel
props.description: Label once the task succeeded.

props.name: trackColor
props.description: Colour behind the bar, and behind the fill on outlined and text.

props.name: type
props.description: `"submit"` submits the enclosing `Form` when pressed, after `onClick`, as on `Button`.

props.name: value
props.description:
What the code says: a URL, a Wi-Fi string, a vCard, any text. Encoded as
UTF-8, in the narrowest of the numeric, alphanumeric and byte modes. The
most a code holds is 2953 bytes at level `"L"`; past that nothing is
drawn and `onError` is called.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description:
What a screen reader says about the code. The value is not read out by
default (it may be a secret). Defaults to `"QR code"`.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: The background, a theme colour token or any colour string. See `color` for the default.

props.name: color
props.description:
The modules: a theme colour token or any colour string. Scanners read dark
modules on a light background, so the default does not follow the theme's
mode: `onSurface` on `surface` in a light theme, `inverseOnSurface` on
`inverseSurface` (still dark on light) in a dark one.

props.name: level
props.description:
How much damage the code survives, and so how big it grows: `"L"` about 7%
of it can be lost, `"M"` 15%, `"Q"` 25%, `"H"` 30%. A `logo` raises it to
`"H"` whatever this says. Defaults to `"M"`.

props.name: logo
props.description:
A mark drawn over the middle of the code: a glyph name, or any node (an
`Image`), centred in a box a fifth of the code wide. The modules under it
are lost, so the level is raised to `"H"`.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called with the error when `value` does not fit in a code, which is then drawn empty.

props.name: quietZone
props.description:
The empty margin around the modules, in modules. Scanners need it to find
the code; the standard asks for 4. Defaults to 4.

props.name: size
props.description: Side of the whole code, quiet zone included, in px. Defaults to 160.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report the selection to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: value
props.description: Current rating; fractions are drawn as a partly filled icon (e.g. 3.5).

props.name: icon
props.description:
The filled glyph. Its `-outline` variant draws the empty state, so it has
to be one that has one (`"heart"` does, `"star"` does). Defaults to `"star"`.

props.name: interval
props.description:
The step of the rating: `1` rates whole icons, `0.5` lets the pointer pick
either half of an icon. Defaults to `1`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Interactive when provided.

props.name: required
props.description:
The rating cannot be cleared: tapping the current value keeps it. Without
it, tapping the current value resets the rating to 0.

props.name: contentContainerStyle
props.description: Style of the view wrapping the children inside the scroll view (padding, `flexGrow`).

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed height of the area. Leave it out to size to the content, up to `maxHeight`.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: The height at which the content starts to scroll.

props.name: onScroll
props.description:
Called on every scroll, like `ScrollView`'s. With `orientation="both"` the
event carries both axes' offset, content size and layout measurement.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
The axis that scrolls. `"both"` nests a horizontal scroll view in a
vertical one, so the content may overflow in either direction. Defaults to
`"vertical"`.

props.name: ref
props.description:
A ref to the scroll view: the vertical one, or the horizontal one for
`orientation="horizontal"`. Use it for `scrollTo`, `scrollToEnd`, …

props.name: scrollbarSize
props.description: Thickness of the scrollbar, in dp: raise it on touch screens for a bigger grab area. Defaults to `10`.

props.name: scrollHideDelay
props.description: How long, in ms, a `scroll` or `hover` scrollbar stays after the last scroll, drag or hover. Defaults to `600`.

props.name: slotStyles
props.description: Style overrides for the track and the thumb.

props.name: style
props.description: Style of the outer view. The scrollbars are laid over it.

props.name: testID
props.description:
Root testID. The scroll view gets `${testID}-viewport` (the horizontal one
of `both`, `${testID}-viewport-x`), each scrollbar `${testID}-scrollbar-vertical` or
`${testID}-scrollbar-horizontal`, and its thumb `${testID}-thumb-vertical`
or `${testID}-thumb-horizontal`.

props.name: type
props.description:
When the scrollbars are visible.
- `auto`: whenever the content overflows.
- `always`: always, overflowing or not.
- `scroll`: while scrolling or dragging, and `scrollHideDelay` after.
- `hover`: while the pointer is over the area (web), and while scrolling
  or dragging. Without a pointer, as on a phone, it behaves like `scroll`.

Defaults to `"auto"`.

props.name: width
props.description: Fixed width of the area.

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Called with the text as it changes. With `debounceTime` it waits until the
user has stopped typing; submitting or clearing reports at once.

props.name: debounceTime
props.description:
Milliseconds the user must stop typing before `onChange` fires. The field
itself always updates at once; a `value` set from outside replaces the
text and drops a pending `onChange`. Defaults to 0: every keystroke.

props.name: icon
props.description: Glyph at the start of the bar. Defaults to `"magnify"`.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called after the clear button empties the field.

props.name: showLoading
props.description:
Tells the bar a search is running: a progress indicator takes the place of
the clear button. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Mount with the option list already open. Uncontrolled after that.

props.name: density
props.description: Control height. `"dense"` is for desktop forms and tables: a 40 px field instead of 52, 14 px text, less space below.

props.name: disabledOptions
props.description:
Options that stay visible but cannot be picked, announced as disabled:
the `value`s to disable, or a pattern tested against each `String(value)`.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown in the open list when `options` is empty. Defaults to `"No options"`.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description:
Stretches the select to its container's width. `false` shrinks it to its
content, with a minimum width. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description:
Where the label is drawn: `"outside"` above the box, or `"inside"`, small,
above the value. Independent of `variant`; with chips showing it stays
above the box. Defaults to `"outside"`.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Picks several options at once; the list stays open. `value` and `onChange` then carry arrays.

props.name: nullable
props.description:
Lets the user go back to no selection: a clear button shows in the field
while an option is selected, and pressing the selected option again
deselects it. Both call `onChange(null)`. Ignored with `multiple`, where
every option can already be unchecked. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Called with the picked option's `value`, or with `null` when a
`nullable` select is cleared. With `multiple`: called with the new array
of selected `value`s on every toggle (a new array, never the one passed
as `value`).

props.name: showAsChips
props.description: With `multiple`, shows the selection as removable chips in the field.

props.name: value
props.description:
The `value` of the selected option, `null` for none. With `multiple`: the
array of selected `value`s (defaults to `[]`).

props.name: variant
props.description:
The look of the box: `"outlined"` is a bordered box on the surface,
`"filled"` a tinted box (like `PinInput`'s) that shows its border only
while focused or in error. Where the label sits is `labelPlacement`'s
business, not the variant's. Defaults to `"outlined"`.

props.name: animate
props.description: false renders a static placeholder (no pulse).

props.name: duration
props.description: Pulse animation duration for a full cycle (ms).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks the pointer, the keyboard and assistive actions, and dims the slider.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report each step the thumb crosses to `ThemeProvider`'s
`onInteractionFeedback` (haptics), as a selection. Only with a `step`: a
continuous slider would report every pixel. Defaults to true.

props.name: interaction
props.description:
What a pointer (finger or mouse) may do: `"both"` drags the thumb and
jumps to where the track is pressed, `"drag"` only drags the thumb,
`"click"` only jumps to the pressed point. The keyboard (arrows, Page
Up/Down, Home/End) and assistive actions work in every mode. Defaults to
`"both"`.

props.name: marks
props.description: Draw a tick at every step (requires step > 0).

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the snackbar is on screen.

props.name: action
props.description: A text button after the message. Clicking it runs `onClick`, then dismisses the snackbar.

props.name: duration
props.description:
Auto-hide delay in ms; `0` keeps it up. Defaults to 4000. Not used when
`onClose` is set.

props.name: icon
props.description: Overrides the icon implied by `severity`.

props.name: onClose
props.description:
Shows a close icon button and keeps the snackbar up until the user
closes it: `duration` is not used, and the timeout never calls
`onDismiss`.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description:
Called when the snackbar times out (after `duration`) or its `action` is
clicked. Not called when `onClose` is set: the snackbar then stays up
until the user closes it.

props.name: position
props.description: Which edge and corner it sits in, clear of the safe-area insets. Defaults to `"bottom-center"`.

props.name: severity
props.description:
What the message is about: `"success"` is green, `"info"` blue,
`"warning"` amber and `"error"` red, with a matching icon. Left out, the
snackbar is the neutral inverse surface, with no icon.

props.name: variant
props.description: `"contained"` fills it with the severity's colours; `"outlined"` draws it on the surface with a severity-coloured outline, label and icon. Defaults to `"contained"`.

props.name: axis
props.description: Which axis `size` applies to. Defaults to `"vertical"`.

props.name: size
props.description: Fixed size along the parent's axis. Omit to absorb the leftover space.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Mount with the action stack already expanded. Uncontrolled after that.

props.name: children
props.description: The primary action's label.

props.name: items
props.description: The related actions the trailing half opens.

props.name: onPress
props.description: The primary action.

props.name: iconName
props.description: Leading icon of the primary action.

props.name: menuAccessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the trailing half. Defaults to `"More options"`.

props.name: mode
props.description: Defaults to `"filled"`.

props.name: max
props.description: No upper limit when unset.

props.name: min
props.description: No lower limit when unset.

props.name: step
props.description: How much the buttons add or take away. A fraction (`0.5`) is fine.

props.name: background
props.description:
Background — a theme colour token (`"surfaceContainer"`) or any colour
string.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Border colour — a theme colour token or any colour string.

props.name: direction
props.description: Stacking axis. Defaults to `"vertical"`.

props.name: dividers
props.description:
Puts a divider between the children. `true` draws a hairline, vertical in
a horizontal stack; a node is used as the divider instead. Empty children
(`null`, `false`) get none, and the spacing applies on both sides of it.

props.name: margin
props.description: Margin on every edge, in px. One edge or one axis goes through `style`.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding on every edge, in px. One edge or one axis goes through `style`.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius — a shape token name or a raw radius.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Reverses the visual order without touching the children array.

props.name: spacing
props.description:
Space between children — a spacing token name (`"m"`), a number of px, or
a string holding one (`"12"`).

props.name: style
props.description: Merged last, over the variant and every other prop.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Lets children flow onto the next line (or column) instead of overflowing.

props.name: label
props.description: What the number measures.

props.name: value
props.description: The number itself; pre-formatted by the caller.

props.name: delta
props.description: Signed change shown next to an up/down arrow, e.g. `"12.5%"`.

props.name: direction
props.description:
`"column"` stacks the label over the value. `"row"` puts them on one line,
the value after the label, with the delta right behind the value. Defaults
to `"column"`.

props.name: helpText
props.description: Extra context under the value.

props.name: trend
props.description: Direction of `delta`. Drives the arrow, and the colour unless `trendColor` is set.

props.name: trendColor
props.description:
The colour of the arrow and `delta`: a theme colour token (a role such as
`"success"` or `"error"`, or `"onSurfaceVariant"`, ...) or any colour string.
Left out, `"up"` is `success`, `"down"` is `error` and `"flat"` neutral. For a
metric where down is good, pass the colour yourself.

props.name: caption
props.description: The label: "Phone", "Due date". Text, or any node.

props.name: captionColor
props.description:
A theme colour token (`"primary"`, `"onSurfaceVariant"`, ...) or any colour
string. Defaults to `onSurfaceVariant`.

props.name: copy
props.description:
Writes the copied text: `expo-clipboard`'s `setStringAsync` on native, or
your own on web. On web it defaults to `navigator.clipboard.writeText`.

props.name: direction
props.description: `"column"` stacks the caption over the value, `"row"` puts them side by side.

props.name: enableCopy
props.description:
Shows a small copy button (a `Clipboard`) after the value, for a text or
number value (a node has nothing to copy). On web it writes the value to
the clipboard (`navigator.clipboard`); the library has no clipboard
dependency, so on native the button is shown only with a `copy` writer or
an `onCopy` that does the copying. The button's icon changes to a check
for a moment, and "Copied" is announced, once the value is copied.

props.name: fallback
props.description:
Drawn when `value` is empty (`null`, `undefined`, `""` or `false`; `0` is a
value). Defaults to `"N/A"`.

props.name: flex
props.description: Flex of the pair in its parent.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between the caption and the value, in px. Defaults to 4.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the pair.

props.name: numberOfLines
props.description: Lines the value may use before it is cut with an ellipsis; `0` is no limit. Defaults to 1.

props.name: omitCaption
props.description: Draws no caption at all, instead of an empty line.

props.name: onCopy
props.description:
Called with the value as text after it was copied. Without a `copy`
writer it is, on native, where the app copies it; on web it is called
after the clipboard write succeeded.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding around the pair, in px.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Puts the value before the caption.

props.name: showTooltip
props.description:
Wraps a text or number value in a `Tooltip` with the value as its content:
the value in full, for when `numberOfLines` cuts it.

props.name: style
props.description: For anything the props above do not cover.

props.name: value
props.description: The value. Text and numbers are drawn in the theme's type; any other node as given.

props.name: valueColor
props.description:
A theme colour token (`"primary"`, `"error"`, ...) or any colour string.
Defaults to `onSurface`.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the pair.

props.name: toneFrom
props.description:
Tints the badge from a `#RRGGBB` colour or from any text instead of from
`type`, which still picks the default icon.

props.name: activeStep
props.description: Position of the current step. Those before it are completed.

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps, in order; a string is a step with just a label.

props.name: direction
props.description:
`"row"` lays the steps out side by side, the label under each circle;
`"column"` stacks them, the label beside each circle. Defaults to `"row"`.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called with the pressed step's position. Makes the steps pressable.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the pressed tab's position and, when it has one, its `key`.

props.name: activeKey
props.description: The active tab by its `key`, for tabs that come and go (by role, by flag).

props.name: activeTab
props.description: The active tab by position. Ignored when `activeKey` is given. Defaults to 0.

props.name: color
props.description: The colour role of the indicator and of the selected tab. Defaults to `"primary"`.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description:
`true` stretches the bar over the width it has and shares it equally
between the tabs. `false` sizes each tab to its label, and the bar scrolls
horizontally when they do not fit. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: height
props.description: Overrides the height of the bar: a number of dp, or a percentage.

props.name: showBorders
props.description:
Draws dividers between the tabs and, in the `"rounded"` variant, an outline
around the track. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: size
props.description: The height and the type of the tabs. Defaults to `"md"`.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"standard"` is a bar with an underline under the active tab. `"rounded"`
is a pill-shaped active tab on a rounded track. Defaults to `"standard"`.

props.name: width
props.description: Overrides the width of the bar: a number of dp, or a percentage.

props.name: children
props.description:
The primitives (`TableHead`, `TableRow`, `TableCell`, ...), when you lay the
rows out yourself. Ignored when `columns` is given.

props.name: columns
props.description:
The columns. Giving them makes the table data driven: it draws `data`
itself. When they add up to more than `width` the table scrolls sideways.

props.name: data
props.description: The rows, as `{ [column id]: cell }`. Data driven only.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown under the header when `data` is empty. Defaults to `"No data"`.

props.name: height
props.description:
Height of the table. With it the rows scroll vertically under a header that
stays in place; without it the table is as tall as its rows.

props.name: hover
props.description: Highlights the row under the pointer, on web; a row with `onClick` also highlights while pressed.

props.name: onClick
props.description:
Called with the row and its index in `data` when a row is pressed. Giving it
makes the rows pressable, with the button role.

props.name: rowsPerPage
props.description:
Rows per page. A number slices `data` into pages and shows a `Pagination`
under the table (hidden while there is no data); the page goes back to the
first when `rowsPerPage` or the number of rows changes. Left out, every row
is drawn in one page.

props.name: selected
props.description:
The row index, or indexes, to draw as selected. An index is a position in
`data`, not in the page shown. The row is marked selected for assistive
technology too.

props.name: tableTitle
props.description: A heading drawn above the header row; also the table's accessible name.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the table. Without it the table fills its container.

props.name: value
props.description: `null` renders `placeholder` instead of a formatted value.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Adds a clear affordance to the field. Needs `onClear` to do anything.

props.name: defaultInputType
props.description:
Which surface the dialog opens on, `"picker"` or typed `"keyboard"` entry.
There is no toggle between the two in the dialog, so this is the only way
to get typed entry there. Default `"picker"`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Mount with the picker already open. Uncontrolled after that.

props.name: endYear
props.description: Last year offered by the year grid. Defaults to 100 years on.

props.name: error
props.description: Error text below the field; also recolors the field.

props.name: fieldVariant
props.description:
The look of the field's box, as `variant` on `Input`: `"outlined"` is a
bordered box on the surface, `"filled"` a tinted box that shows its border
only while the picker is open, the typed text has focus, or there is an
`error`. Named apart from `variant`, which already chooses between the
field and the inline picker. Does nothing for `variant="static"`, which has
no field. Defaults to `"outlined"`.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Defaults to the locale's own week start.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: inputEnabled
props.description: Lets the user type the value straight into the field. Default `true`.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Excludes days `validRange` cannot express (weekends, a computed holiday set).

props.name: labels
props.description: Chrome strings of the picker surface (nav buttons, "Today", "OK", …).

props.name: locale
props.description: Overrides the formatting/labelling locale. Defaults to the device locale.

props.name: minuteInterval
props.description: Minute granularity of the clock. Defaults to 1.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field has no value.

props.name: presentation
props.description:
Web only, `variant="default"` only: whether the picker opens docked to its
field or as a dialog. Decided each time it opens. Native always opens the
dialog. Defaults to `"auto"`.

props.name: relativeLabels
props.description:
Overrides the relative day labels, e.g. from i18n:
`relativeLabels={{ today: t("TODAY"), yesterday: t("YESTERDAY") }}`.
Defaults to the device locale via Intl.RelativeTimeFormat.

props.name: required
props.description: Appends an asterisk to the label.

props.name: scrollMode
props.description: Month navigation inside the dialog. Default `"endless"`.

props.name: showOkButton
props.description:
Shows the OK button in the popup. Default `true`. Set to `false` and the
picker finishes by itself instead of waiting for OK: a time is set and the
popup closes once the minute is picked (`mode="datetime"`: after the day,
the hour and the minute), and a date range once its second end is. A single
date already closes on the tap. It has no effect on `selectionMode="multiple"`,
which cannot tell when it is finished, nor on typed entry
(`defaultInputType="keyboard"`), which keeps its OK; and a
`variant="static"` picker has no popup, so it does nothing there.

props.name: showToday
props.description:
Offers a "Today" button next to the month arrows. Default `true`. Only a
single-date calendar has one, and it is disabled while today is outside
`validRange` or excluded by `isDateDisabled`.

props.name: startYear
props.description: First year offered by the year grid. Defaults to 100 years back.

props.name: use24HourClock
props.description: Forces the 24-hour clock face. Left unset, the locale decides.

props.name: validRange
props.description: The selectable window plus individual excluded days.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"default"` shows a field that opens the picker in a popover (web) or a
dialog; dismiss it by tapping outside, with the back gesture or with Escape.
`"static"` draws the picker inline in the page instead: no field, no popup,
no OK, and every selection calls `onChange` at once with the live value.
Of the field props only `disabled` and `style` apply to a static picker, and
it always shows the calendar and the clock, never typed entry.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the switch, or its label, is pressed.

props.name: containerStyle
props.description: Style for the outer Pressable.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report the switch to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: height
props.description: Track height; the thumb scales with it. Defaults to the `size`'s (18 for medium).

props.name: label
props.description: Text next to the switch. Pressing it toggles the switch too.

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description:
Where the label sits relative to the switch: `"start"` and `"end"` are
the left and right in a left-to-right layout, `"top"` and `"bottom"`
stack them. Defaults to `"end"`.

props.name: size
props.description:
Switch size: `"small"` is 24 x 14, `"medium"` 32 x 18, `"large"` 40 x 22.
`width` and `height` override it. Defaults to `"medium"`.

props.name: width
props.description: Track width. Defaults to the `size`'s (32 for medium).

props.name: accessibilityRole
props.description: Accessibility role. The group sets this per its selection mode.

props.name: grow
props.description: Stretch to an equal share of the group's width.

props.name: showSelectedCheck
props.description:
Swap the leading glyph for a check mark while selected — the M3 segmented
button affordance that tells "selected" apart from "just highlighted".

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Names the group for assistive tech — a group of choices needs a question.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every segment.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report each press (a toggle with `multiSelect`, else a selection) to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Segments share the row equally instead of sizing to their labels.

props.name: showSelectedCheck
props.description: Show a check mark on the selected segments (M3 segmented button).

props.name: children
props.description: The actions: `IconButton`s, a `Button`, a `SplitButton`.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Names the toolbar for assistive tech.

props.name: color
props.description:
Floating only. `"standard"` is `surfaceContainer`; `"vibrant"` is
`primaryContainer` — give its actions `onPrimaryContainer` content.
Defaults to `"standard"`.

props.name: fab
props.description: Floating only: a FAB beside the toolbar, as M3 pairs them.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Floating only. Defaults to `"horizontal"`.

props.name: safeArea
props.description: Docked only: pads the bottom safe-area inset. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"docked"` spans the width of the screen's bottom edge (it replaces the
bottom app bar); `"floating"` is a pill that floats over the content.
Defaults to `"docked"`.

props.name: content
props.description:
The tip's text; the body of a rich tooltip, which can also be laid out (a
small sum, a list). A node never names the anchor: give the rich tooltip a
`title` for that.

props.name: action
props.description:
Rich only: a text button. A rich tooltip with an action stays open while
the pointer is over it (web) and until the action is taken or the anchor
is long-pressed again (native).

props.name: anchorAccessible
props.description:
Native only. Whether the anchor is one accessibility element named by
`content`. Turn it off when the child is a control with a name of its own
(an `IconButton`): behind an accessible wrapper a screen reader never
reaches the control, only the wrapper, which does nothing when activated.
The long press still shows the tip. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: enterDelay
props.description:
Hover dwell (ms) before the tip appears on web. Without it, sweeping the
pointer across a toolbar flashes every tooltip in the row.

props.name: hideDelay
props.description: Auto-hide delay (ms) after long-press on native.

props.name: leaveDelay
props.description: Grace period (ms) before the tip leaves on hover-out.

props.name: title
props.description: Rich only: the subhead.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"plain"` is the one-line label for an icon-only control. `"rich"` adds a
`title` and an `action`, for context a label cannot carry. Defaults to
`"plain"`.

props.name: activeStyle
props.description: Extra style applied only while hovered (web) or pressed.

props.name: borderless
props.description: Skip the container background so the layer only tints the child.

props.name: borderRadius
props.description: Matches the parent's corner radius so the layer doesn't bleed out.

props.name: rippleColor
props.description:
Colour of the state layer itself — the M3 "on" role of the surface.
Defaults to `onSurface`.

props.name: underlayColor
props.description: Surface the state layer is drawn over. Defaults to `surface`.

props.name: data
props.description: The roots. Keep the array (and the nodes in it) stable between renders: rows whose node did not change are not drawn again.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Names the tree for assistive tech.

props.name: checkboxes
props.description:
With `selectionMode="multiple"`, a checkbox on each row: checking a parent
checks everything under it, and a parent with only some children checked
shows the mixed state. Ignored in the other modes. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: The ids of the nodes that start open, when `expanded` is not set.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The ids that start selected, when `selected` is not set.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be opened, selected or focused. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: expanded
props.description: The ids of the open nodes. Set, the tree is controlled: it opens and closes what this says, and reports through `onExpandedChange`.

props.name: indent
props.description: How far each level is pushed in, in px. Defaults to 24.

props.name: loadChildren
props.description:
Fetches the children of a node marked `hasChildren` when it is first
opened; a loading row shows meanwhile, and a retry row if the promise
rejects. The result is kept: the node is not asked again.

props.name: loadingText
props.description: The text of the loading row. Defaults to `"Loading…"`.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the open ids after a node is opened or closed.

props.name: onLoadError
props.description: Called when `loadChildren` rejects.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called with the selected ids after a press, a Space or an Enter on a row.

props.name: renderLabel
props.description:
Draws the label of a row instead of `node.label`. Rows are memoised: pass
a function that does not change between renders (`useCallback`), or every
row is drawn again whenever the tree is.

props.name: retryText
props.description: The text of the row that retries a failed load. Defaults to `"Could not load. Try again"`.

props.name: selected
props.description:
The ids of the selected nodes: at most one with `selectionMode="single"`.
With checkboxes it lists every checked node, a parent whose children are
all checked included. Set, the tree is controlled.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description:
What pressing a row does. `"none"` opens and closes it, `"single"` selects
it (and only it), `"multiple"` toggles it in the selection. The chevron
always opens and closes. Defaults to `"none"`.

props.name: showLines
props.description: Draws a vertical guide line down each open node's children. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: size
props.description: Row height and text size: 32, 40 or 48 px. Defaults to `"medium"`.

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal alignment of the text within its box.

props.name: color
props.description:
A theme colour token (`"primary"`, `"onSurfaceVariant"`, `"error"`, …) or,
failing that, any colour string. Defaults to `onSurface`.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Overrides the size of the variant; the line height scales with it.

props.name: nowrap
props.description: Keeps the text on one line, ending it with an ellipsis when it is cut.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Makes the text pressable.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Type-scale name: `h1`–`h6`, `subtitle1`, `subtitle2`, `body1`, `body2`,
`button`, `caption`, `overline`. The M3 role names (`displayLarge`,
`bodyMedium`, …) still work and name the same styles. Defaults to `"body1"`.

props.name: accept
props.description:
What may be picked, written like the `accept` of an `<input type="file">`:
`"image/*,.pdf"`. It filters the web file dialog and is checked on every
file added, on every platform (a drop, or what `onPick` returns).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The files the list starts with, when it is not controlled.

props.name: error
props.description: An error message under the field, in the error colour.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: label
props.description: A label above the field.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: How many files the list may hold with `multiple`: the ones past it are rejected.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: The largest file, in bytes: a bigger one is rejected.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allows several files. Without it a new file replaces the one in the list. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the whole list whenever it changes: files added or removed, a status or a progress moved.

props.name: onPick
props.description:
Opens a picker and resolves the files chosen (an empty list for none): the
app wires `@its/glowup-device/media-picker` or a document picker here. The
library imports no picker. On native it is required for the field to be
drawn; on web it replaces the browser's file dialog when given.

props.name: onReject
props.description:
Called with the files that were not added (too large, wrong type, past
`maxFiles`). Without it the reasons are shown under the field.

props.name: onUpload
props.description:
Uploads each new file. Return a promise that resolves when it is done and
rejects when it failed; report `onProgress` as it goes and stop on
`signal`. The file is listed as `"uploading"` with its progress, then
`"done"`, or `"error"` with a retry button. Without it files are only
collected (`"pending"`), for you to send with a form.

props.name: prompt
props.description:
What the dropzone or the button says. Defaults to "Drag files here or
click to browse" in a web dropzone, else "Choose files" ("Choose a file"
without `multiple`).

props.name: value
props.description: The files in the list. Give it with `onChange` to control the list.

props.name: variant
props.description: `"dropzone"` is a dashed area to drop files on or press; `"button"` is a plain button (a drop on it still works on web). Defaults to `"dropzone"`.

props.name: above
props.description: Shows from this window size class up (`"medium"` is medium, expanded, large, …).

props.name: below
props.description: Shows only on size classes smaller than this one (`"medium"` is compact only).

props.name: fallback
props.description: Rendered in place of the children while they are not shown.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description:
Hides the children with `display: "none"` instead of unmounting them, so
their state survives. They are then wrapped in a `View` (laid out as if it
were not there while they show). Defaults to `false`.

props.name: only
props.description: Shows only on this size class, or on any of these.

props.name: when
props.description: A condition of your own; the children show only while it holds. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: density
props.description:
The default `density` of every control inside (`Input`, `Select`, `Button`,
`DataGrid`); a control's own `density` prop still wins. A nested provider
without one inherits the outer one's. Defaults to `"normal"`.

props.name: initialPalette
props.description:
The colour set to start on — one of `palettes`, or anything
`createPalette` returns. Read once, on mount: call `setPalette` from
`useTheme()` to change it afterwards.

props.name: onInteractionFeedback
props.description:
Called when the user presses, toggles or selects through one of the
library's controls: wire it to haptics (`@its/glowup-device/haptics`'s
`hapticFeedback`) or anything else. A control opts out with
`feedback={false}`. Without it a nested provider inherits the outer one's.

props.name: themeScrollbars
props.description:
On the web, draws the browser's own scrollbars from the theme (a thin thumb
in the `outline` colour, no arrows) and sets `color-scheme` to the theme's
mode, so a textarea's or a list's scrollbar is not a light box in a dark
page. One rule on the document, rewritten when the theme changes; a
`ScrollArea` still hides its native bar. Pass `false` to leave the browser's
scrollbars alone. Defaults to `true`; does nothing on iOS and Android.

props.name: maxVisible
props.description:
How many toasts are on screen together. The others wait in the queue and
appear, in order, as a slot frees. Defaults to `1`: one at a time. At a
given position they stack with a gap, the newest nearest the edge.

props.name: position
props.description: Where toasts appear unless one asks for another. Defaults to `"bottom-center"`.

props.name: code
props.description: The source to colour.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hides the text from assistive technology, for a copy that only decorates (a field's own text is read instead).

props.name: language
props.description: What the source is written in. Defaults to `"tsx"`.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Lets the reader select the text.

props.name: style
props.description: Merged after the code type: padding, font size.

props.name: badge
props.description: Trailing text, e.g. an unread count: `24`, `"100+"`.

props.name: children
props.description:
Sub-items (`DrawerItem`s): makes this a group. Pressing it toggles them,
and they are indented one level. Hidden while the drawer is `collapsed`.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: For a group: start open. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading glyph. The active state strips an "-outline" suffix.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Optional for an item with `children`, whose press opens and closes them.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: For a group: called with the new state after the user toggles it.

props.name: selected
props.description: Whether this is the current destination.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Makes the title a button that opens and closes the items. Needs a `title`.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: For a collapsible section: start open. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: For a collapsible section: called with the new state after the user toggles it.

props.name: showDivider
props.description: Draws a divider above the section — between it and the one before.

props.name: title
props.description: Section headline.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report each selection to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: background
props.description:
Background — a theme colour token (`"surfaceContainer"`) or any colour
string.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Border colour — a theme colour token or any colour string.

props.name: dividers
props.description:
Puts a divider between the children. `true` draws a hairline, vertical in
a horizontal stack; a node is used as the divider instead. Empty children
(`null`, `false`) get none, and the spacing applies on both sides of it.

props.name: margin
props.description: Margin on every edge, in px. One edge or one axis goes through `style`.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding on every edge, in px. One edge or one axis goes through `style`.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius — a shape token name or a raw radius.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Reverses the visual order without touching the children array.

props.name: spacing
props.description:
Space between children — a spacing token name (`"m"`), a number of px, or
a string holding one (`"12"`).

props.name: style
props.description: Merged last, over the variant and every other prop.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Lets children flow onto the next line (or column) instead of overflowing.
